## End-to-End Device Logistics
## Calm, Compliant, On Time.

Since 1999, Amtel has supported carriers, retailers, and enterprise programs across the GCC with
multi-brand electronics. We run a single, standards-led playbook: model-list confirmation,
IMEI/serial validation, HS codes and packing specs, and channel-compliant documentation—so timelines
stay clear and handovers remain predictable.

With operating entities in the UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Saudi Arabia, we stay close to customers
and standards. We are Apple Authorized in Kuwait and carry strong lines including Samsung, Honor,
Redmi, Tecno, and Sony, plus PlayStation, Nintendo, and Xbox—bringing measured reliability to
launches and replenishment.

clearance, and zerotolerance quality control, supporting partners from first PO to final store
delivery.

## **Honoring the Life and Legacy of Izzy Schwab **

D&H Distributing mourns the passing of Izzy Schwab, Chairman Emeritus and a lifelong steward of
the company.

Izzy's leadership, humility, and belief in people helped shape D&H into what it is today, serving
partners and communities across North America. His values continue to guide the teams at D&H.
Those wishing to share a memory or reflection are invited to visit our digital tribute wall.

[Visit Our Tribute Wall and Share Your Stories][40]

In lieu of flowers, the family has shared that those who wish to honor Izzy's memory may consider
a contribution to either of these two organizations, causes close to his heart.

Make-A-Wish
Philadelphia, Delaware & Susquehanna Valley

[Donate Here][41]

Humane Society of Harrisburg Area/Central PA

[Donate Here][42]

The family will be having a private funeral, however we also plan to host a Celebration of Life at a
future date at D&H Headquarters that will be open to friends, partners, and members of the D&H
community. For those unable to attend in person, additional ways to participate or share
sentiments will be made available.

# Leading technology distribution: services and products for your business

We are enablers of the tech ecosystem with a profound calling to social and environmental
sustainability. To foster tech-democracy and accompany individuals and companies on their path to
technological innovation, Esprinet brings to Europe a comprehensive offer of consultancy, IT
security, services, and products for sale or rent through an extensive network of professional
resellers.

[ Become a client ][61]
[ Find out more ][62]

We are enablers of the technology ecosystem and, according to our philosophy, any project
characterized by technology must have a deep vocation for environmental and social sustainability.

We believe that new technologies represent a common good. That is why we are dedicated to being the
point of reference among the communities of technology manufacturers, retailers, and users.

Manufacturers

We work with more than 850 vendors, supplying their technologies to more than 30,000 business
vendors and consumers.

[ Find out more ][63]

Vendor

Being part of our network also means having a precise and clear view of the technology world's
trends and progress.

[ Find out more ][64]

Users

Our experience in the market and our extensive network enable us to stimulate the implementation of
technological innovations in business processes by directing companies, but also private users, to
the most suitable resellers.

[ Find out more ][65]

# Leading technology distribution: services and products for your business

We are enablers of the tech ecosystem with a profound calling to social and environmental
sustainability. To foster tech-democracy and accompany individuals and companies on their path to
technological innovation, Esprinet brings to Europe a comprehensive offer of consultancy, IT
security, services, and products for sale or rent through an extensive network of professional
resellers.

[ Become a client ][61]
[ Find out more ][62]

We are enablers of the technology ecosystem and, according to our philosophy, any project
characterized by technology must have a deep vocation for environmental and social sustainability.

We believe that new technologies represent a common good. That is why we are dedicated to being the
point of reference among the communities of technology manufacturers, retailers, and users.

Manufacturers

We work with more than 850 vendors, supplying their technologies to more than 30,000 business
vendors and consumers.

[ Find out more ][63]

Vendor

Being part of our network also means having a precise and clear view of the technology world's
trends and progress.

Users

Our experience in the market and our extensive network enable us to stimulate the implementation of
technological innovations in business processes by directing companies, but also private users, to
the most suitable resellers.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Ingram Micro is a leading technology company for the global information technology ecosystem. With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to a highly diversified base of business-to-business technology experts. Through Ingram Micro Xvantage™, our AI-powered digital platform, we offer what we believe to be the industry’s first comprehensive business-to-consumer-like experience, integrating hardware and cloud subscriptions, personalized recommendations, instant pricing, order tracking, and billing automation. We also provide a broad range of technology services, including financing, specialized marketing, and lifecycle management, as well as technical pre- and post-sales professional support. Learn more at www.ingrammicro.com.

Jomashop believes that everyone should be able to wear what they love, and do so with savings in mind. We do this by allowing shoppers to quickly and easily find exactly what they want from over 650 leading international brands and 75,000 unique items. We pride ourselves on our ability to deliver the best prices, most varied selection and finest service for well over 25 years. Our goal has and always will be to earn the trust and satisfaction of our customers. We understand that this means providing the perfect combination of competitive pricing, customer service and a state of the art, New York City based fulfillment center capable of delivering products to every corner of the world.

## About Sharif Group

The Group trades under its legalname "Mohamed Sharif Mohamed & Sons B.S.C.©", a closed Bahraini
shareholding Company registered in the Kingdom of Bahrain with the Ministry of Industry and Commerce
under commercial registration number 598 obtained on 6 February 1974.

[ EXPLORE MORE][14]

## A la Mode

A La Mode, a division of Sharif Group, started in 1995 as a brand trading in fashion accessories,
writing instruments, and leather items, in addition to the well- known watches line which dates back
to 1971.

[SHOP ONLINE][15]

## Sharif Garments Factory

Sharif Garments is the leading supplier of official & civil uniforms in the Kingdom of Bahrain. It
has developed strong and lasting relationships for many years and supplied uniforms for commercial,
industrial, oil, hospitality, educational, military, security establishments

[SHOP ONLINE][16]

## Wool House

Wool House is the brand name for the trading and retailing of textiles arm of the Group. We offer
wide range of most internationally-acclaimed brands of textiles through our outlets in different
shopping malls,

[SHOP ONLINE][17]

## Parfume

The newest addition to the leading retail company Sharif Group, is being introduced as a new concept
in the world of perfumery.

The new division is distinguished in the market due to the gained expertise over the years. As well
as offering a luxurious environment and a customer oriented layout, with fragrances at the
customer’s fingertips, all which suit the sophistication and class of modern perfumery customers.

[SHOP ONLINE][18]

## Let the numbers speak

The Group entry into tailoring business in the 1960's during the development of Bahrain's commercial
and retail industries marked an era of fine tailoring in Bahrain.From its humble beginning, the
enterprise expanded into the trade of watches in 1971

Farnell Global trades as Newark in the Americas, Farnell in Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Japan, and element14 across Asia Pacific. _crawl.linkedin_about: We are RS Group. Making Amazing Happen for a Better World. ONE BRAND. ONE TEAM. ONE CULTURE. We provide the product and service solutions that help our customers design, build, maintain, repair and operate industrial equipment and operations, safely and sustainably. We are the trusted and preferred partners of designers, builders and maintainers of industrial equipment and operations. Since 1937, we have supported generations of engineers with products for all types of applications. Through 86 years we've seen technologies develop and inspirations come to life. Whatever the innovation or industry, RS will continue to support the engineers of tomorrow. With operations in 34 countries, we offer more than 850,000 products to over one million customers, shipping around 60,000 parcels a day. Our products, sourced from 2,500 leading suppliers, include electronic components, electrical, automation and control, and test and measurement equipment, and engineering tools and consumables. DesignSpark connects millions of makers, innovators, students, and design engineers from around the world with a collaborative space and design resources to improve productivity. Our award-winning software, model libraries, tech updates, inspiration and learning help fire up the ordinary and ignite the extraordinary. Our purpose is to educate, influence, promote and enable engineers to design responsibly, for a better world. Our aim is to breed innovation and help every engineer to bring their ideas to life faster. Our DesignSpark community helps do this by connecting over 450,000 registered engineers to like-minded people across the world where they can share projects, ideas and expertise. We are now RS Group plc, formerly Electrocomponents plc, the global distributor for engineers.

## Welcome to SAVEX

Your trusted ICT distribution partner with over 38 years of legacy in the industry. As one of the
prominent leaders in the distribution and technological solutions industry, Savex is determined to
deliver a quality experience to satisfy our clients with our services and facilitate businesses to
succeed in the current age of digital evolution.

Savex Technologies is headquartered in Mumbai, with 107 sales offices  and 42 stocking locations
strategically spread across different regions of India.

This extensive reach, helps us to cater over 12,000 customers monthly, reaching out to over 1000
cities nationwide.

With the commitment to serve excellence, we bring to the table, and the market, top quality
distribution and technological solutions.

By working with TechVision, you unlock the full potential of technology for your business. _crawl.linkedin_about: More than 60 years ago, Sam Walton opened the first Walmart in Rogers, Arkansas. Today, we’re a people-led, tech-powered omnichannel retailer dedicated to helping people save money and live better all around the world. Our 2.1 million associates are the engine behind what we do — serving customers and members in communities spanning 19 countries, in stores and clubs, online and through a supply chain built for speed and scale. We’re committed to creating clear pathways for associates to learn, grow and advance. Whether you’re starting your first job or bringing years of experience, you’ll find room to grow, learn new skills and build a career with purpose. We’re proud to invest in our people and foster a culture grounded in respect, integrity, service and striving for excellence. Recognized as a Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® (2025) and Great Place To Work®-Certified™ , we’re proud of what we’re building together.

Hybrid Smartwatch OEM & Brand Licensing

# We turn iconic brands into intelligent timepieces.

Globics Technologies designs, engineers and manufactures premium hybrid smartwatches. Classic
analogue beauty, fused with connected technology and delivered end to end under your brand.

[Start a partnership][9] [See our work with Pininfarina][10]
[Gold-cased Pininfarina Pura hybrid smartwatch by Globics, showing the optical heart-rate sensor
glowing green and red on the sapphire caseback, with a navy leather strap on a black background]
**Pininfarina Hybrid · Pura**
30 days
Battery life on a single 60-minute charge
5 ATM
Water resistance with 316L stainless steel & sapphire
$12.5B
Global hybrid smartwatch market and growing
End‑to‑end
Design, manufacturing, app, fulfilment & support
Why hybrid

## The watch they already love, made intelligent.

A hybrid keeps the analogue beauty customers want on the wrist, then quietly adds the connected
features they expect. No screen to charge every night, no compromise on style.

[Black hybrid watch with an analogue dial and a cutaway revealing the smart electronics inside]
01

### An authentic mechanical soul

A genuine mechanical dial with sweeping hands and a discreet micro-display, not a glass rectangle
pretending to be a watch. It reads as jewellery first, technology second.

[Hybrid watch resting on a charging cable showing 74 percent charging]
02

### A month on a single charge

Up to 30 days of battery from a single 60-minute charge. Wearers stop thinking about power and
simply wear the watch.

[Close-up of a hybrid watch dial with a health sub-display and a blue heart icon]
03

### Wellness, quietly observed

Heart rate, sleep, activity, SpO₂ and wellness tracking run silently in the background and sync to a
companion app on iOS and Android.

[Detail of a hybrid watch with leather strap on woven rattan]
04

### Crafted to outlast trends

316L surgical-grade steel, scratch-resistant sapphire crystal, 5 ATM water resistance and Italian
leather or FKM straps.

[Man glancing at a black hybrid watch on his wrist]
05

### Connection, with discretion

Calls, messages, calendar and movement nudges surface through the sub-dial and subtle haptics, never
a buzzing distraction.

Analogue soul, smart heart

## Two worlds, engineered into one.

Mechanical movement and connected intelligence, brought together inside a single refined case.

What we do

## A single partner for the entire wearable.

From first sketch to the watch on your customer's wrist, Globics owns the complexity so your brand
can own the moment.
1. 01
   
   ### Industrial & product design
   
   Brand-true case, dial, strap and UX design that translates your heritage into a desirable,
   wearable object.
2. 02
   
   ### Hardware engineering
   
   Optical heart-rate, SpO₂, accelerometer and GPS-compass sensor modules engineered into refined
   hybrid movements.
3. 03
   
   ### Companion app development
   
   Proprietary iOS & Android apps for health, wellness, sleep and training, fully white-labelled to
   your brand.
4. 04
   
   ### Manufacturing at scale
   
   Premium materials, tight tolerances and quality control across a proven global manufacturing
   supply chain.
5. 05
   
   ### Global distribution & fulfilment
   
   eCommerce, marketplace and retail fulfilment with worldwide shipping, warranty and after-sales
   support.
6. 06
   
   ### Brand licensing programmes
   
   Structured licensing, like our Pininfarina agreement, that protects your equity while we run the
   product.

Materials & finishes

## Built from the inside out.

Surgical-grade 316L stainless steel, scratch-resistant sapphire crystal, genuine Italian leather and
FKM rubber straps. Every piece is engineered around a precision hybrid movement and a sensor stack
tuned for years of quiet reliability.

**316L**Stainless steel case
**Sapphire**Anti-scratch crystal
**5 ATM**Water resistance
**30 days**Battery per charge
How we partner

## Flexible models, one accountable partner.

Whether you need full-service brand licensing, OEM manufacturing of your design, or an ODM platform
ready to brand, Globics owns delivery end to end.

### Discover

We align on your brand, audience, positioning and the commercial model: licence, OEM or ODM.

### Design

Industrial design, dial UX and companion-app experience crafted to your brand guidelines.

### Engineer & build

Hardware engineering, sampling, certification and quality-controlled manufacturing at scale.

### Launch & sustain

Global fulfilment, eCommerce, retail, warranty and after-sales, all under your name.

## Let's build a watch the world wants to wear.

Tell us about your brand and the audience you want to reach. We'll show you what a Globics hybrid
smartwatch partnership can look like.

_crawl.about: Globics Technology is a wholly-owned subsidiary of National Electronics (Consolidated) Limited, an investment holding company that manufactures, assembles, and sells electronic watches and watch parts internationally, including the People’s Republic of China, North America, and Europe. Our high-performance products go beyond mere timekeeping. They encompass a broad spectrum of features that promote personal well-being, from nuanced fitness and wellness tracking to sleep monitoring and advanced sports analytics. By leveraging the potential of these technologies, we empower our customers to lead healthier, more balanced lives. Each of our products is a testament to superior design and technological innovation, brought to life by an international team of top-tier industrial designers hailing from Hong Kong and Europe. Our multidisciplinary design approach ensures that each piece we produce is not just aesthetically appealing, but also built to last, reflecting our commitment to high-quality, sustainable production. At Globics, we firmly believe that our dedication to sustainability sets us apart. It's not just about reducing our environmental footprint; it's about enriching the lives of our customers and contributing positively to the world around us. In every aspect of our operations, sustainability isn't just a priority — it's our guiding principle. We are proud to be at the forefront of the sustainable tech revolution, creating products that are as kind to the planet as they are beneficial to our customers. We focus on four types of platforms, divided based on their specification and functions: Hybrid, Hybrid Advanced, Hybrid Premium and Digital Smart Watch.

## Maintaining Consistent, High-quality Inventory Is the Lifeblood of Your Business

As industry leaders in refurbishing and supplying New & Second hand mobile devices, we understand

Four reasons why thousands of businesses have trusted US Mobile Phones to supply their used mobile
devices.

##### For any-sized order, shipped anywhere in the world, we’ve got you covered.

Located in the heart of the tri-state area near four major airports and two seaports, our
100,000-square-foot, R2 and ISO certified facility is ideal for fast, international shipping. No
matter how large your order, you can count on it arriving where and when you need it.

##### Consistent quantities at competitive prices. (Because we hate surprises as much as you do.)

Our inventory is sourced directly from top phone carriers and manufacturers. By cutting out the
middleman, we can ensure consistent quantities and competitive prices, which means higher profits
for you.

##### Responsive reps that never keep you waiting for answers.

Our customer service team will always keep you updated about the status of your order and resolve
issues quickly in the rare case that something doesn’t go as planned. Got questions? We respond to
all inquiries within the same business day.

##### We’re not just a supplier; we’re a strategic partner.

We take the time to learn about your business and offer creative solutions to help you grow—whether
it’s expanding your product line, keeping you informed about emerging market trends, or extending a
credit line to help your cash flow.
[Work with us][19]

#### FEATURES & BENEFITS

# The Quality and Service You Expect, Without the Headaches You Hate

Orders shipped **within one business day**. Drop shipping available.

Each unit **sanitized, data-wiped, & graded** to the strictest industry standards.
Kitting solutions and** customized packaging** upon request.

**24-hour RMA response** in the event that you’re not happy with your order.

Our 100,000 sq. ft. facility houses **large** **quantities of inventory** ready to ship.

Our **team is on call** to answer your questions within one business day.

### Maintaining the Highest Quality and Environmental Standards Since 2000

## Ready to Power Up Your Profits?

We help you do it in four simple steps:

### **We get to know you**

We’ll start with a brief conversation to learn about your business and send you a simple application
to get started.

### **You pick your stock**

Once your application is accepted, we’ll send you a stock list that suits your needs, so you can
browse prices and inventory.

### **You place an order**

After placing an order, your devices will be shipped within 24 hours. We’ll always follow up to
ensure you received your order.

### **We help you grow**

As your strategic partner, we take a hands-on approach, offering guidance & solutions to help you
grow your business.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Exostretch is a Technology Transfer Start-Up, surrounding a patented thin-film, stretchable battery technology from the University of Houston's Division of Research. Exostretch consists of a management team: Ross Smolen, Akshay Joshi, Dat Vu, and Nathaniel Scott, Public Relations director: Triet Tran, and research team: Dr. Haleh Ardebili Ph.D., Dr. Mejdi Kammoun Ph.D., and Anujan Murugesu. Exostretch is advised by Mary Hakam and Mounir Zok. Mary Hakam is the president of Woodlands Textiles and has created technical textile clothing systems for NASA, WL Gore, and special operations forces. Mounir Zok is the director of technology and innovation for the United States Olympic Committee. _crawl.linkedin_about: Founded in 2006, Point Mobile is one of the fastest growing enterprise handheld manufacturers in the world, with a strong focus in OEM and ODM devices until 2012. For years, we have made devices for companies such as Honeywell, Datalogic and even Ingenico for mobile payment devices. Based on the increased ODM/OEM experience and expertise, Point Mobile's own brand of devices was introduced in 2013, offering a full range of handheld mobile computers, rugged smartphones, LTE/Android integrated mobile payment devices, healthcare terminals, RFID readers and portable Bluetooth scanners. In addition, we provide a broad portfolio of comprehensive accessories such as multi-slot cradles, vehicle chargers or holders. Latest Android and Windows operating systems and software solutions such as EmKit prepare our customers for the future. As opposed to other larger manufacturers, we do everything in-house, and build our devices vertically with own resources, which not only guarantees high product quality but gives us fast turnaround time on new projects, suited to global standards. Point Mobile is one of the leading experts in enterprise mobility and No.1 in the domestic market. We strive to provide an enhanced user experience - made possible through strong partnerships. Contact us for more information, and find out what we can do for your business. Point Mobile is a KOSDAQ listed company under the code 318020:KS.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Assured Systems is a leading technology company offering high quality and innovative computer solutions to the embedded, industrial, and digital-out-of-home market sectors. You will find our products in a diverse range of applications throughout our key verticals, which include energy, transportation, defence, automation, process control, medical, asset tracking, narrowcasting, gaming and multimedia. Truly Global Reach With offices in the UK and USA, Assured Systems was founded by senior executives of high-technology organisations with global experience. Our vision was to create a truly innovative company which offers customers the best technology available, whilst keeping a keen focus on quality, reliability, long-term support and ultimately, value. This methodology ensures everyone in the supply chain stays competitive and ahead of their rivals – we’re redefining the win-win mentality needed for successful partnerships. Expertise This is what sets Assured Systems apart from our peers. Our sales team has over 15 years experience in the industrial and embedded marketplace, and we consider ourselves consultants, rather than typical account managers. We thoroughly understand our products, our customers, their markets, and the applications in which our systems are being deployed. You can rely on our expertise to ensure you receive the right guidance resulting in a precise fit for your requirements every time, saving you time and effort, and ultimately money. Call us on +44 1785 879050 (EMEA) and +1 347 719 4508 (USA) or visit www.assured-systems.com for more information.

# FAQ

#### What does Argentek specialize in?

Argentek is a global wholesale electronics distributor offering competitive prices on bulk consumer
electronics. We supply resellers, retailers, and B2B buyers with high-demand technology products and
streamline logistics for international delivery.

#### Do you ship electronics internationally?

Yes, we specialize in international electronics shipping. We ship bulk tech products to Europe,
Latin America, Oceania, Africa, Asia-Pacific, and North America, leveraging trusted logistics
partners to ensure fast, secure delivery.

#### How do I become a wholesale partner or client?

Fill out our wholesale onboarding form or schedule a discovery call to get started. Once approved,
you’ll get full access to our pricing tiers, shipping policies, and dedicated account support.

# Leading technology distribution: services and products for your business

We are enablers of the tech ecosystem with a profound calling to social and environmental
sustainability. To foster tech-democracy and accompany individuals and companies on their path to
technological innovation, Esprinet brings to Europe a comprehensive offer of consultancy, IT
security, services, and products for sale or rent through an extensive network of professional
resellers.

[ Become a client ][61]
[ Find out more ][62]

We are enablers of the technology ecosystem and, according to our philosophy, any project
characterized by technology must have a deep vocation for environmental and social sustainability.

We believe that new technologies represent a common good. That is why we are dedicated to being the
point of reference among the communities of technology manufacturers, retailers, and users.

Manufacturers

We work with more than 850 vendors, supplying their technologies to more than 30,000 business
vendors and consumers.

[ Find out more ][63]

Vendor

Being part of our network also means having a precise and clear view of the technology world's
trends and progress.

[ Find out more ][64]

Users

Our experience in the market and our extensive network enable us to stimulate the implementation of
technological innovations in business processes by directing companies, but also private users, to
the most suitable resellers.

[ Find out more ][65]

the establishment of its international channel system, consistently ranking among the first tier of
core authorized distributors for Xiaomi global-version products.

## About Sharif Group

The Group trades under its legalname "Mohamed Sharif Mohamed & Sons B.S.C.©", a closed Bahraini
shareholding Company registered in the Kingdom of Bahrain with the Ministry of Industry and Commerce
under commercial registration number 598 obtained on 6 February 1974.

[ EXPLORE MORE][14]

## A la Mode

A La Mode, a division of Sharif Group, started in 1995 as a brand trading in fashion accessories,
writing instruments, and leather items, in addition to the well- known watches line which dates back
to 1971.

[SHOP ONLINE][15]

## Sharif Garments Factory

Sharif Garments is the leading supplier of official & civil uniforms in the Kingdom of Bahrain. It
has developed strong and lasting relationships for many years and supplied uniforms for commercial,
industrial, oil, hospitality, educational, military, security establishments

[SHOP ONLINE][16]

## Wool House

Wool House is the brand name for the trading and retailing of textiles arm of the Group. We offer
wide range of most internationally-acclaimed brands of textiles through our outlets in different
shopping malls,

[SHOP ONLINE][17]

## Parfume

The newest addition to the leading retail company Sharif Group, is being introduced as a new concept
in the world of perfumery.

The new division is distinguished in the market due to the gained expertise over the years. As well
as offering a luxurious environment and a customer oriented layout, with fragrances at the
customer’s fingertips, all which suit the sophistication and class of modern perfumery customers.

[SHOP ONLINE][18]

## Let the numbers speak

The Group entry into tailoring business in the 1960's during the development of Bahrain's commercial
and retail industries marked an era of fine tailoring in Bahrain.From its humble beginning, the
enterprise expanded into the trade of watches in 1971

## Welcome to SAVEX

Your trusted ICT distribution partner with over 38 years of legacy in the industry. As one of the
prominent leaders in the distribution and technological solutions industry, Savex is determined to
deliver a quality experience to satisfy our clients with our services and facilitate businesses to
succeed in the current age of digital evolution.

Savex Technologies is headquartered in Mumbai, with 107 sales offices  and 42 stocking locations
strategically spread across different regions of India.

This extensive reach, helps us to cater over 12,000 customers monthly, reaching out to over 1000
cities nationwide.

With the commitment to serve excellence, we bring to the table, and the market, top quality
distribution and technological solutions.

and manufacturing of smart wearable products.

Hybrid Smartwatch OEM & Brand Licensing

# We turn iconic brands into intelligent timepieces.

Globics Technologies designs, engineers and manufactures premium hybrid smartwatches. Classic
analogue beauty, fused with connected technology and delivered end to end under your brand.

[Start a partnership][9] [See our work with Pininfarina][10]
[Gold-cased Pininfarina Pura hybrid smartwatch by Globics, showing the optical heart-rate sensor
glowing green and red on the sapphire caseback, with a navy leather strap on a black background]
**Pininfarina Hybrid · Pura**
30 days
Battery life on a single 60-minute charge
5 ATM
Water resistance with 316L stainless steel & sapphire
$12.5B
Global hybrid smartwatch market and growing
End‑to‑end
Design, manufacturing, app, fulfilment & support
Why hybrid

## The watch they already love, made intelligent.

A hybrid keeps the analogue beauty customers want on the wrist, then quietly adds the connected
features they expect. No screen to charge every night, no compromise on style.

[Black hybrid watch with an analogue dial and a cutaway revealing the smart electronics inside]
01

### An authentic mechanical soul

A genuine mechanical dial with sweeping hands and a discreet micro-display, not a glass rectangle
pretending to be a watch. It reads as jewellery first, technology second.

[Hybrid watch resting on a charging cable showing 74 percent charging]
02

### A month on a single charge

Up to 30 days of battery from a single 60-minute charge. Wearers stop thinking about power and
simply wear the watch.

[Close-up of a hybrid watch dial with a health sub-display and a blue heart icon]
03

### Wellness, quietly observed

Heart rate, sleep, activity, SpO₂ and wellness tracking run silently in the background and sync to a
companion app on iOS and Android.

[Detail of a hybrid watch with leather strap on woven rattan]
04

### Crafted to outlast trends

316L surgical-grade steel, scratch-resistant sapphire crystal, 5 ATM water resistance and Italian
leather or FKM straps.

[Man glancing at a black hybrid watch on his wrist]
05

### Connection, with discretion

Calls, messages, calendar and movement nudges surface through the sub-dial and subtle haptics, never
a buzzing distraction.

Analogue soul, smart heart

## Two worlds, engineered into one.

Mechanical movement and connected intelligence, brought together inside a single refined case.

What we do

## A single partner for the entire wearable.

From first sketch to the watch on your customer's wrist, Globics owns the complexity so your brand
can own the moment.
1. 01
   
   ### Industrial & product design
   
   Brand-true case, dial, strap and UX design that translates your heritage into a desirable,
   wearable object.
2. 02
   
   ### Hardware engineering
   
   Optical heart-rate, SpO₂, accelerometer and GPS-compass sensor modules engineered into refined
   hybrid movements.
3. 03
   
   ### Companion app development
   
   Proprietary iOS & Android apps for health, wellness, sleep and training, fully white-labelled to
   your brand.
4. 04
   
   ### Manufacturing at scale
   
   Premium materials, tight tolerances and quality control across a proven global manufacturing
   supply chain.
5. 05
   
   ### Global distribution & fulfilment
   
   eCommerce, marketplace and retail fulfilment with worldwide shipping, warranty and after-sales
   support.
6. 06
   
   ### Brand licensing programmes
   
   Structured licensing, like our Pininfarina agreement, that protects your equity while we run the
   product.

Materials & finishes

## Built from the inside out.

Surgical-grade 316L stainless steel, scratch-resistant sapphire crystal, genuine Italian leather and
FKM rubber straps. Every piece is engineered around a precision hybrid movement and a sensor stack
tuned for years of quiet reliability.

**316L**Stainless steel case
**Sapphire**Anti-scratch crystal
**5 ATM**Water resistance
**30 days**Battery per charge
How we partner

## Flexible models, one accountable partner.

Whether you need full-service brand licensing, OEM manufacturing of your design, or an ODM platform
ready to brand, Globics owns delivery end to end.

### Discover

We align on your brand, audience, positioning and the commercial model: licence, OEM or ODM.

### Design

Industrial design, dial UX and companion-app experience crafted to your brand guidelines.

### Engineer & build

Hardware engineering, sampling, certification and quality-controlled manufacturing at scale.

### Launch & sustain

Global fulfilment, eCommerce, retail, warranty and after-sales, all under your name.

## Let's build a watch the world wants to wear.

Tell us about your brand and the audience you want to reach. We'll show you what a Globics hybrid
smartwatch partnership can look like.

Individual approach to training

service allows you to adjust your program without unnecessary difficulties.
Your workouts — your way

#### FAQs

## Which all products do Intex offer?

Intex deals in all major consumer electronics products including LED TV, Washing Machine, Air
Conditioner, Air Cooler, Speakers, IFPD, and IT Accessories.

## Can I buy Intex products directly from the website?

No, we do not offer direct online purchases. Instead, you can raise an enquiry for the product
you’re interested in, and our team will help you with the purchase process.

## How can I place a bulk/corporate gifting order query?

Please visit our corporate gifting page and submit your bulk order (URL:
https://www.intex.in/pages/bulk-enquiry). Our corporate sales team will assist you promptly.

## Are Intex products available on eCommerce platforms?

Yes. Intex products are also available on leading eCommerce platforms including Amazon, Flipkart,
and Zepto.

## Is Intex an Indian electronics brand?

Yes. Intex is a leading Indian consumer electronics brand, operating since 1996.

range covers kids GPS watches, senior health watches, fitness trackers, and more. From our factory

waterproof. Result: Zero deformation under high pressure. Your data stays safe in any environment.

Advanced Biometric Sensor

elliptical, rowing, suggesting corresponding sports mode.

high (240MHz) and low (96MHz) CPUs, it auto-switches, achieving 60 FPS and reducing power usage by
30%.

lifestyle. View call history, manage contacts, answer/reject calls on the watch during outdoor
activities, house chores, or cooking.

vibrant 3D effects, and dynamic animations.

The Open-SmartWatch is an open source project created by [@pauls_3d_things][25]/[p3dt.net][26]. It
consists of hardware modules, 3D printable cases and a custom operating system to build smartwatches
with the goal that they can be assembled, repaired, and modified by everyone. There are currently
two versions:
* [Light edition][27] (released)
* [GPS edition][28] (preview, work in progress)

Check out the apps to see what the watch can do!
* [Watchfaces][29]
* [Tools][30]
* [Games][31]

See the following pages for:
* [Hardware][32]: for ordering PCBs, or assembled watches
* [Firmware][33]: for infos on flashing the latest firmware
* [3D-Files][34]: for 3D-printable design files
* [Open-Smartwatch-OS][35]: the source code on GitHub. The main branch should be stable, the develop
  branch is usually more up to date and can be unstable.
* [p3dt's discord/open-smartwatch channels][36]: to join the discussion and learn how to contribute

## Media Coverage
* `@pauls_3d_things` on [Instagram][37] (Latest Updates)
* `#opensmartwatch` on [Instagram][38] (See what the community creates)
* `pauls_3d_things` on [Youtube][39] (Tutorials + Instructions)
* Linus Tech Tips: [It's time.][40]
* Hackaday: [An Open Source Smart Watch you'd actually wear][41]
* CNX-Software: [LilyGo sells Open-Smartwatch open-source hardware ESP32 watch by “Paul’s 3D
  Things”][42]
* hackster.io: [Something ESPecially Impressive about the Open-Smartwatch Project][43]

## Sponsors
* [Aisler B. V.][44] provided PCBs to support the hardware development
* [PCBgogo][45] provided PCBs to support the hardware development

* [GPS edition][28] (preview, work in progress)

Check out the apps to see what the watch can do!
* [Watchfaces][29]
* [Tools][30]
* [Games][31]

See the following pages for:
* [Hardware][32]: for ordering PCBs, or assembled watches
* [Firmware][33]: for infos on flashing the latest firmware
* [3D-Files][34]: for 3D-printable design files
* [Open-Smartwatch-OS][35]: the source code on GitHub. The main branch should be stable, the develop
  branch is usually more up to date and can be unstable.
* [p3dt's discord/open-smartwatch channels][36]: to join the discussion and learn how to contribute

## Media Coverage
* `@pauls_3d_things` on [Instagram][37] (Latest Updates)

* `pauls_3d_things` on [Youtube][39] (Tutorials + Instructions)

  Things”][42]
* hackster.io: [Something ESPecially Impressive about the Open-Smartwatch Project][43]

## Star64 featuring RISC-V

The **Star64** is PINE64's first RISC-V SBC. It comes with a StarFive JH7110 64bit CPU sporting quad

## Ox64

RISC-V CPU. It offers Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and ZigBee connectivity.

## Pinecil

The **Pinecil** is a smart mini portable soldering iron with a 32-bit RISC-V SoC featuring a sleek
design, auto standby and it heats up to an operating temperature in just 6 seconds!


[View the details][14]

a detachable keyboard.

## PineNote

The **PineNote** is the first hybrid notepad computer device combination of notebook, tablet and
e-reader using an e-ink panel.


[View the details][17]

## PineTime

The **PineTime** is a free and open source smartwatch capable of running custom-built open operating
systems.

# The **PINE64** community

Our goal is to push the envelope and deliver ARM and RISC-V devices that you want to use and develop
for. To this end, we actively work with the development community and champion end-user initiatives.
Rather than applying business to a FOSS setting, we allow FOSS principles to guide our business.

We are available on Discord, IRC, Matrix and Telegram, in the Forum and on Reddit.

**[Join our community][19]**

## Our products, your impact

For the past four years, we’ve provided information to over one billion users annually to help them
make more sustainable choices through our products.¹ And in 2025, nine of our solutions helped
individuals, cities, and partners collectively reduce an estimated 41 million tCO2e²—equivalent to
the emissions from the annual electricity use of over 8.5 million U.S. homes.³

[Google Maps display showing a 14-minute eco-friendly route with a leaf icon and a gray 12-minute
alternative.]

### Take the fuel-efficient route

Looking for a route that saves time and money?

[Try it now][16]
[Gas pump icon]

We estimate that fuel-efficient routing enabled over 3 million tCO2e reductions in 2025⁴—equivalent
to taking roughly 700,000 gasoline-powered cars off the road for a year.⁵

[Try it now][17]
[Aerial view of a building's solar heatmap alongside a Building Insights panel showing solar
potential metrics.]

### Estimate your solar savings

How much could you save by switching?

[Try it now][18]
[Icon of a leaf with a lightning bolt]

Solar savings estimator uses AI and satellite imagery to analyze roof space, weather, tree shade,
and installation costs for millions of buildings, so you can decide if solar is best for you.

[Try it now][19]
[Overhead view of hands repairing an open Google Pixel phone with tweezers on a wooden table.]

### Use your devices longer

What if you could reduce e-waste and save money?

[Try it now][20]
[Icon of a computer and phone]

Our Pixel 10 series is built to last, with seven years of OS and security updates and made with the
most recycled content of any Pixel phone generation yet.⁶ In fact, Pixel 10a is made with at least
36% recycled materials.⁷

[Try it now][21]
[Mobile interface mockup showing a pre-owned blue winter coat priced at $75.00 with a 4.5-star
rating.]

### Shop pre-owned

Want to find unique and affordable items new to you?

[Try it now][22]

## Our products, your impact

For the past four years, we’ve provided information to over one billion users annually to help them
make more sustainable choices through our products.¹ And in 2025, nine of our solutions helped
individuals, cities, and partners collectively reduce an estimated 41 million tCO2e²—equivalent to
the emissions from the annual electricity use of over 8.5 million U.S. homes.³

[Google Maps display showing a 14-minute eco-friendly route with a leaf icon and a gray 12-minute
alternative.]

### Take the fuel-efficient route

Looking for a route that saves time and money?

[Try it now][16]
[Gas pump icon]

We estimate that fuel-efficient routing enabled over 3 million tCO2e reductions in 2025⁴—equivalent
to taking roughly 700,000 gasoline-powered cars off the road for a year.⁵

[Try it now][17]
[Aerial view of a building's solar heatmap alongside a Building Insights panel showing solar
potential metrics.]

### Estimate your solar savings

How much could you save by switching?

[Try it now][18]
[Icon of a leaf with a lightning bolt]

Solar savings estimator uses AI and satellite imagery to analyze roof space, weather, tree shade,
and installation costs for millions of buildings, so you can decide if solar is best for you.

[Try it now][19]
[Overhead view of hands repairing an open Google Pixel phone with tweezers on a wooden table.]

### Use your devices longer

What if you could reduce e-waste and save money?

[Try it now][20]
[Icon of a computer and phone]

Our Pixel 10 series is built to last, with seven years of OS and security updates and made with the
most recycled content of any Pixel phone generation yet.⁶ In fact, Pixel 10a is made with at least
36% recycled materials.⁷

[Try it now][21]

## Committed to the efficient and responsible use of resources

We’re dedicated to advancing sustainability across our operations, from improving AI efficiency to
procuring carbon-free energy and replenishing water. We’re strengthening the circular economy by
designing out waste and implementing 100% plastic-free packaging. We’re also investing in
next-generation clean energy technologies like advanced nuclear and enhanced geothermal. Below is a
snapshot of our progress in 2025.

[Modern building with undulating canopy roofs reflected in a calm lake as the sun shines through the
glass.]
[Two people with backpacks walk along a paved path bordered by wildflowers and lush green trees.]
[Energy savings leaf]

### Procured over 12 GW of clean energy

Google is one of the largest corporate purchasers of clean energy in the world. In 2025, we signed
agreements to purchase over 12 GW of net-new clean energy⁹—the largest annual total in our history
and more than our total procurement from the previous two years combined.

[Lightning bolt icon]

### New TPUs deliver up to 2x better performance-per-watt¹⁰

Our eighth-generation custom AI chips (TPU 8t, optimized for training, and TPU 8i, optimized for
inference) deliver up to two times better performance-per-watt over Ironwood, our seventh-generation
TPU.¹¹

[Icon of a cloud with fog lines]

### Avoided 58M tCO₂e across our value chain

In 2025 alone, initiatives like machine hardware efficiencies, software and compute efficiencies,
and clean energy procurement collectively avoided over 58 million tCO2e.¹²

[Water droplet icon]

### Replenished 78% of our total freshwater consumption

In 2025, our water stewardship projects replenished roughly 78% of our total freshwater
consumption—or 7.7 billion gallons of water.¹³

## From Product Requirements to Mass Production

WearIntell follows a structured OEM/ODM development process to help wearable brands evaluate
requirements, confirm technical feasibility, develop prototypes, complete testing, and prepare for
scalable production.
01 | Requirement Communication & Project Evaluation
We review your product goals, target users, key features, deployment scenarios, and business
requirements before defining the project scope.
02 | Technical Assessment & Solution Planning
Our team evaluates hardware, firmware, sensor, connectivity, battery, and platform requirements to
confirm the right technical path.
03 | Project Confirmation & Development Kickoff
After project scope, timeline, and cooperation details are confirmed, the development process starts
with clear milestones and responsibilities.
04 | Industrial Design, Hardware & Prototype Development
We support ID design, structural design, PCB development, component selection, and prototype
validation based on project requirements.
05 | Software, App & Certification Testing
Firmware, app features, cloud integration, reliability testing, and certification preparation are
completed before production readiness review.
06 | Pilot Production & Mass Delivery
We validate production quality through trial production, then move into mass production, inspection,
packaging, and scheduled delivery.

# ERP knows the plan. Your shopfloor does something else

Workerbase connects your systems to your shopfloor operations, making sure what you plan on your ERP
and scheduled on your MES actually happens.

[Book a demo][3][Watch 2-minute demo][4]

Trusted by manufacturers running the most complex operations in the world

[Bosch]
[Siemens]
[thyssenkrupp]
[Porsche]
[GKN]
[Gazelle]
[Dantherm]

## Most plants fix problems in silos Workerbase bridges the gaps between them

One platform connecting every function on your shopfloor, so quality, maintenance, logistics, and
production move together, not in parallel. Explore each solution below.

ProductionMaintenanceQualityMaterial and LogisticsShopfloor

### Production

From the workstation to the line, every step is guided, every deviation caught and every stop
logged. Instructions enforced at the station: steps confirmed before the next opens, line stops
captured with reason and duration in real time, SAP updated automatically – no re-entry, no
end-of-shift catch-up.
* Digital work instructions & video SOPs
* Video-to-Checklist
* Paperless Batch / SAP
* OEE & Downtime Tracking

[Production team executing assembly operations on automotive line]
[Explore manual assembly][5][Explore machine operations][6]

## Here's why leading manufacturers use Workerbase

[Workerbase at the center connected to enterprise integrations including SAP, Siemens, Oracle,
Google Cloud, Microsoft Teams, Slack, and Dynamics 365]

### Connect your systems

Plug in SAP, MES, SCADA, IoT sensors, or any data source via 100+ out-of-the-box integrations.
Workerbase turns that data into actionable tasks.

[Workflow builder with media input and mobile preview]

### Build your workflows

Your ops teams configure digital workflows, work instructions, and checklists in a no-code editor.
No IT project. No custom development. Live on one line in 2 weeks.

[Workerbase experience across tablet, phone, scanner, and smartwatch]

### Deploy to any device

Workers receive tasks and instructions on any device: tablet, smartphone, industrial smartwatch, or
kiosk. The right information, at the right station, in real time.

[Digital dashboard with issues, KPIs, and automated actions]

### Analyze and improve

Stronger analytics, faster value: real-time production and asset insight, gap detection, and the
KPIs that matter, from execution data your teams already create.

Workerbase AI agents

## Five AI agents to get started

Purpose-built AI that works inside your existing workflows – not bolted on as a separate tool. Each
agent solves one specific shopfloor problem. Live in days, not months.

### Troubleshooting agent

Operators get real-time, actionable resolution steps for alarms and disruptions – combining error
history and SOPs. No phone call. No manual.

### Data collector agent

Step-by-step guided data capture during events. Like an AI-driven, context-aware form. No blank
fields, no inconsistent formats.

### Incoming goods AI

Scan a delivery note. AI matches it to the ERP order, guides verification, posts the receipt
straight to the system. Dock to ERP in seconds.

### Find agent

Natural-language search across documents, checklists, videos and internal knowledge – answers in
seconds, directly at the station.

### Knowledge agent

Convert videos, audio or photos into structured digital work instructions. Knowledge captured simply
by recording. Publish the same day.

[Learn More][7]

## One platform, three ways it changes how the team works

### Shopfloor Operators

Real-time guidance at every station – the right instruction when it matters. Clear steps, confirmed
and done.

### Supervisors

Visibility across lines and shifts with less chasing. Escalations and reports largely handle
themselves so you focus on what matters.

### Operations Teams

Ship digitalization without IT overhead: configure workflows in hours and prove value before you
scale.

## What operations look like after closing the execution gap

Without Workerbase
With Workerbase

Finding information

Paper trails, multiple screens, calling the one person who knows.
Right information at the station. No searching, no waiting.

Training new staff

Weeks of shadowing. Knowledge locked in people's heads.
Guided from day one. Knowledge built into every workflow.

Shift handover

Manual and inconsistent. Things get lost at every handover.
Automatic, structured, complete. Nothing falls through.

Knowledge retention

Leaves with the worker when they go.
Embedded in the system. Available to everyone, always.

Creating workflows

Weeks of IT tickets and change requests.
Operations team configures and deploys. Hours, not months.

Reacting to problems

Supervisor scrambles. Manual workarounds. Same issue repeats next week.
Structured escalation from alarm to closure. Every step logged.

OEM/ODM services for **sports/pocket cameras and smartwatches**. We are committed to delivering
innovative imaging devices and wearables that help you capture life’s moments, enhance fitness
routines, and enrich daily life.
 
As a leading manufacturer in China, we offer end-to-end solutions for both product lines: for
cameras, we cover gimbal system design, 2K/4K image tuning, noise reduction audio processing, WiFi
connectivity, and mobile app integration; for smartwatches, we provide full support from ID & MD
design to firmware development and UI customization. All services are backed by our 30-member strong
R&D team.
 
Join us at Weiwo as we embark on a journey towards a smarter and more connected world, one camera
and one smartwatch at a time.

The Signatur Collection

Characterized by clean lines, uncluttered dials, and artful use of negative space, this bestselling
platform encapsulates modern style and Scandinavian minimalism by elevating detailing in its
simplest form.

[Shop Mellem][139]

The Mellem Collection

The Mellem embodies minimalist design by striking a perfect balance between geometric forms. Its
sculptural case seamlessly blends a circle with a square, inspired by Scandinavian artists and
architects who harmoniously merge nature's curves with tactile geometry.

[Shop His][140] [Shop Hers][141]
[feature of pearls jewelry]
[Shop Jewelry][142]

Jewelry

Our jewelry pieces are effortlessly modern and uniquely refined, bringing a fresh approach to
everyday basics. Designed with organic shapes and minimalist details, they offer versatility and
comfort, perfect for layering and creating a sleek, polished statement.

[Shop His][143] [Shop Hers][144]

Skagen celebrates the Danish way of life: free, spontaneous, and in the moment. Our watches and
jewelry are fueled by a love of modern design––playing with color and current fashion influences.

We’re energized by the Copenhagen fashion scene and emerging Danish designers who mix and match bold
colors and patterns.

We’re finding refreshed inspiration in Denmark’s landscape—iridescent seas, vibrant skies, rocky
shorelines. Our modern designs draw from these natural influences.

We're dialed-in to purposeful design that speaks to the now—modern, functional, simple pieces with
enduring characteristics.

**Welcome to Avelr Smartwatches!**

At Avelr, we take pride in offering innovative and high-quality smartwatches for children and
adults. Whether you’re looking for advanced GPS tracking, fitness monitoring, or customizable
features, we are here to cater to your needs.

If you have any questions or specific requirements, don’t hesitate to reach out to us. Our team is
ready to assist you. Send us an email at **[[email protected]][26]**, and we’ll provide you with
detailed assistance promptly!

### **Discover Avelr's Featured Smartwatches for Kids and Adults**

**
**Explore our curated selection of Avelr smartwatches, with a focus on models designed specifically
for kids. Our children’s smartwatches offer essential features like GPS tracking, health monitoring,
and Bluetooth calling, providing both safety and connectivity for young users. Additionally, browse
select models tailored for adults, ideal for fitness tracking, wellness, and outdoor adventures. For
our full range of smartwatches, visit our complete catalog.

### **New & Improved - Explore Avelr's Latest Featured Smartwatches**

**
**Discover the innovative and stylish smartwatches in our featured collection. From kid-friendly GPS
tracking and Bluetooth calling watches to advanced health and fitness trackers for adults, Avelr’s
latest models combine technology and style. Perfect for parents looking for safety features or
fitness enthusiasts aiming to reach their health goals. Dive into our selection and find the
smartwatch that fits your lifestyle.

**Welcome to Avelr Smartwatches!**

At Avelr, we take pride in offering innovative and high-quality smartwatches for children and
adults. Whether you’re looking for advanced GPS tracking, fitness monitoring, or customizable
features, we are here to cater to your needs.

If you have any questions or specific requirements, don’t hesitate to reach out to us. Our team is
ready to assist you. Send us an email at **[[email protected]][26]**, and we’ll provide you with
detailed assistance promptly!

**
**Explore our curated selection of Avelr smartwatches, with a focus on models designed specifically
for kids. Our children’s smartwatches offer essential features like GPS tracking, health monitoring,
and Bluetooth calling, providing both safety and connectivity for young users. Additionally, browse
select models tailored for adults, ideal for fitness tracking, wellness, and outdoor adventures. For
our full range of smartwatches, visit our complete catalog.

### **New & Improved - Explore Avelr's Latest Featured Smartwatches**

**
**Discover the innovative and stylish smartwatches in our featured collection. From kid-friendly GPS
tracking and Bluetooth calling watches to advanced health and fitness trackers for adults, Avelr’s
latest models combine technology and style. Perfect for parents looking for safety features or
fitness enthusiasts aiming to reach their health goals. Dive into our selection and find the
smartwatch that fits your lifestyle.

## Which all products do Intex offer?

Intex deals in all major consumer electronics products including LED TV, Washing Machine, Air
Conditioner, Air Cooler, Speakers, IFPD, and IT Accessories.

## Can I buy Intex products directly from the website?

No, we do not offer direct online purchases. Instead, you can raise an enquiry for the product
you’re interested in, and our team will help you with the purchase process.

## How can I place a bulk/corporate gifting order query?

Please visit our corporate gifting page and submit your bulk order (URL:
https://www.intex.in/pages/bulk-enquiry). Our corporate sales team will assist you promptly.

## Are Intex products available on eCommerce platforms?

Yes. Intex products are also available on leading eCommerce platforms including Amazon, Flipkart,
and Zepto.

## Is Intex an Indian electronics brand?

Yes. Intex is a leading Indian consumer electronics brand, operating since 1996.

## Our products, your impact

For the past four years, we’ve provided information to over one billion users annually to help them
make more sustainable choices through our products.¹ And in 2025, nine of our solutions helped
individuals, cities, and partners collectively reduce an estimated 41 million tCO2e²—equivalent to
the emissions from the annual electricity use of over 8.5 million U.S. homes.³

[Google Maps display showing a 14-minute eco-friendly route with a leaf icon and a gray 12-minute
alternative.]

### Take the fuel-efficient route

Looking for a route that saves time and money?

[Try it now][16]
[Gas pump icon]

We estimate that fuel-efficient routing enabled over 3 million tCO2e reductions in 2025⁴—equivalent
to taking roughly 700,000 gasoline-powered cars off the road for a year.⁵

[Try it now][17]
[Aerial view of a building's solar heatmap alongside a Building Insights panel showing solar
potential metrics.]

### Estimate your solar savings

How much could you save by switching?

[Try it now][18]
[Icon of a leaf with a lightning bolt]

Solar savings estimator uses AI and satellite imagery to analyze roof space, weather, tree shade,
and installation costs for millions of buildings, so you can decide if solar is best for you.

[Try it now][19]
[Overhead view of hands repairing an open Google Pixel phone with tweezers on a wooden table.]

### Use your devices longer

What if you could reduce e-waste and save money?

[Try it now][20]
[Icon of a computer and phone]

Our Pixel 10 series is built to last, with seven years of OS and security updates and made with the
most recycled content of any Pixel phone generation yet.⁶ In fact, Pixel 10a is made with at least
36% recycled materials.⁷

[Try it now][21]
[Mobile interface mockup showing a pre-owned blue winter coat priced at $75.00 with a 4.5-star
rating.]

### Shop pre-owned

Want to find unique and affordable items new to you?

[Try it now][22]
[Shopping bag icon]

The fashion industry accounts for ~8% of global carbon emissions,⁸ so our clothing choices matter.
Selecting the “used” filter in Google Shopping surfaces products with the pre-owned badge, making it
easier to save money and extend the life of existing items.

[Try it now][23]
[Explore all products][24]

## Committed to the efficient and responsible use of resources

We’re dedicated to advancing sustainability across our operations, from improving AI efficiency to
procuring carbon-free energy and replenishing water. We’re strengthening the circular economy by
designing out waste and implementing 100% plastic-free packaging. We’re also investing in
next-generation clean energy technologies like advanced nuclear and enhanced geothermal. Below is a
snapshot of our progress in 2025.

[Modern building with undulating canopy roofs reflected in a calm lake as the sun shines through the
glass.]
[Two people with backpacks walk along a paved path bordered by wildflowers and lush green trees.]
[Energy savings leaf]

### Procured over 12 GW of clean energy

Google is one of the largest corporate purchasers of clean energy in the world. In 2025, we signed
agreements to purchase over 12 GW of net-new clean energy⁹—the largest annual total in our history
and more than our total procurement from the previous two years combined.

[Lightning bolt icon]

### New TPUs deliver up to 2x better performance-per-watt¹⁰

Our eighth-generation custom AI chips (TPU 8t, optimized for training, and TPU 8i, optimized for
inference) deliver up to two times better performance-per-watt over Ironwood, our seventh-generation
TPU.¹¹

[Icon of a cloud with fog lines]

### Avoided 58M tCO₂e across our value chain

In 2025 alone, initiatives like machine hardware efficiencies, software and compute efficiencies,
and clean energy procurement collectively avoided over 58 million tCO2e.¹²

[Water droplet icon]

### Replenished 78% of our total freshwater consumption

In 2025, our water stewardship projects replenished roughly 78% of our total freshwater
consumption—or 7.7 billion gallons of water.¹³

## From Product Requirements to Mass Production

WearIntell follows a structured OEM/ODM development process to help wearable brands evaluate
requirements, confirm technical feasibility, develop prototypes, complete testing, and prepare for
scalable production.
01 | Requirement Communication & Project Evaluation
We review your product goals, target users, key features, deployment scenarios, and business
requirements before defining the project scope.
02 | Technical Assessment & Solution Planning
Our team evaluates hardware, firmware, sensor, connectivity, battery, and platform requirements to
confirm the right technical path.
03 | Project Confirmation & Development Kickoff
After project scope, timeline, and cooperation details are confirmed, the development process starts
with clear milestones and responsibilities.
04 | Industrial Design, Hardware & Prototype Development
We support ID design, structural design, PCB development, component selection, and prototype
validation based on project requirements.
05 | Software, App & Certification Testing
Firmware, app features, cloud integration, reliability testing, and certification preparation are
completed before production readiness review.
06 | Pilot Production & Mass Delivery
We validate production quality through trial production, then move into mass production, inspection,
packaging, and scheduled delivery.

# ERP knows the plan. Your shopfloor does something else

Workerbase connects your systems to your shopfloor operations, making sure what you plan on your ERP
and scheduled on your MES actually happens.

[Book a demo][3][Watch 2-minute demo][4]

Trusted by manufacturers running the most complex operations in the world

[Bosch]
[Siemens]

## Most plants fix problems in silos Workerbase bridges the gaps between them

One platform connecting every function on your shopfloor, so quality, maintenance, logistics, and
production move together, not in parallel. Explore each solution below.

ProductionMaintenanceQualityMaterial and LogisticsShopfloor

### Production

From the workstation to the line, every step is guided, every deviation caught and every stop
logged. Instructions enforced at the station: steps confirmed before the next opens, line stops
captured with reason and duration in real time, SAP updated automatically – no re-entry, no
end-of-shift catch-up.
* Digital work instructions & video SOPs
* Video-to-Checklist
* Paperless Batch / SAP
* OEE & Downtime Tracking

[Production team executing assembly operations on automotive line]
[Explore manual assembly][5][Explore machine operations][6]

## Here's why leading manufacturers use Workerbase

[Workerbase at the center connected to enterprise integrations including SAP, Siemens, Oracle,
Google Cloud, Microsoft Teams, Slack, and Dynamics 365]

### Connect your systems

Plug in SAP, MES, SCADA, IoT sensors, or any data source via 100+ out-of-the-box integrations.
Workerbase turns that data into actionable tasks.

[Workflow builder with media input and mobile preview]

### Build your workflows

Your ops teams configure digital workflows, work instructions, and checklists in a no-code editor.
No IT project. No custom development. Live on one line in 2 weeks.

[Workerbase experience across tablet, phone, scanner, and smartwatch]

### Deploy to any device

Workers receive tasks and instructions on any device: tablet, smartphone, industrial smartwatch, or
kiosk. The right information, at the right station, in real time.

[Digital dashboard with issues, KPIs, and automated actions]

### Analyze and improve

Stronger analytics, faster value: real-time production and asset insight, gap detection, and the
KPIs that matter, from execution data your teams already create.

Workerbase AI agents

## Five AI agents to get started

Purpose-built AI that works inside your existing workflows – not bolted on as a separate tool. Each
agent solves one specific shopfloor problem. Live in days, not months.

### Troubleshooting agent

Operators get real-time, actionable resolution steps for alarms and disruptions – combining error
history and SOPs. No phone call. No manual.

### Data collector agent

Step-by-step guided data capture during events. Like an AI-driven, context-aware form. No blank
fields, no inconsistent formats.

### Incoming goods AI

Scan a delivery note. AI matches it to the ERP order, guides verification, posts the receipt
straight to the system. Dock to ERP in seconds.

### Find agent

Natural-language search across documents, checklists, videos and internal knowledge – answers in
seconds, directly at the station.

### Knowledge agent

Convert videos, audio or photos into structured digital work instructions. Knowledge captured simply
by recording. Publish the same day.

[Learn More][7]

## One platform, three ways it changes how the team works

### Shopfloor Operators

Real-time guidance at every station – the right instruction when it matters. Clear steps, confirmed
and done.

### Supervisors

Visibility across lines and shifts with less chasing. Escalations and reports largely handle
themselves so you focus on what matters.

### Operations Teams

Ship digitalization without IT overhead: configure workflows in hours and prove value before you
scale.

## What operations look like after closing the execution gap

Without Workerbase
With Workerbase

Finding information

Paper trails, multiple screens, calling the one person who knows.
Right information at the station. No searching, no waiting.

Training new staff

Weeks of shadowing. Knowledge locked in people's heads.
Guided from day one. Knowledge built into every workflow.

Shift handover

Manual and inconsistent. Things get lost at every handover.
Automatic, structured, complete. Nothing falls through.

Knowledge retention

Leaves with the worker when they go.
Embedded in the system. Available to everyone, always.

Creating workflows

Weeks of IT tickets and change requests.
Operations team configures and deploys. Hours, not months.

Reacting to problems

Supervisor scrambles. Manual workarounds. Same issue repeats next week.
Structured escalation from alarm to closure. Every step logged.
